Kind note for first-time travelers
It is easier with this note
Companion Animal Travel Desk Notice

Travelers need to check pet paperwork, crate fit, and comfort basics before they arrive. We keep things moving best when you bring a calm animal, clear labels, and the right care notes for the trip.

Our team looks at species, temperament, and travel comfort so the plan matches the pet, not just the booking. <<FACT F117>> If a delay happens at departure, keep your boarding pass and speak up fast so the desk can guide the next step. <<FACT F109>>

Please also keep food, water, and any needed meds easy to reach, and tell the staff about any stress signs right away. Aurelia Skyways wants steady, safe companion travel, and the Companion Animal Travel Desk is here to help. Please come to the Companion Animal Travel Desk for help before boarding.
